Delegations Walk Out During Trump's UN Speech

During a speech at the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday, U.S. President Donald Trump made critical remarks about Cuba, stating the country would "fall." In response, the Cuban delegation walked out of the assembly. Separately, the Iranian delegation also walked out during Trump's address. Trump had previously threatened Iran with "annihilation."
